name: Hwei Blank Canvas
creator: aletuno
description:
A colorful Texture And VFX recolor of Hwei.

The main direction of the skin is to mix colors with every key.

QQ is Blue

WW is Green

EE is Red

QW or WQ would be Cyan

QE or EQ would be Magenta

WE or EW would be Yellow

Passive is White + Rainbow

R is Black + Rainbow
